Chief_Complaint.source_text: CC:** Breathing difficulty after wasp sting

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient was stung by a wasp while gardening approximately 15 minutes ago and then ran inside.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Wasp sting while gardening ~15 min ago; ran inside

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Since the wasp sting, the patient has experienced shallow breathing and chest tightness.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Since then: shallow breathing, chest tightness

History_of_Present_Illness.content: The patient reports a tingling sensation of the lips.
The patient denies a sensation of throat closing.
The patient reports a blotching rash on the skin.
The patient has had no prior similar reactions.
The patient is calling to determine if he needs to go to the hospital.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Pt calling to determine if needs hospital

Medications.content: Patient has antihistamines at home; specific name not specified.

Social_and_Family_History.content: Patient's wife is present at home and can assist.
Social_and_Family_History.source_text: • Wife present at home; can assist

Assessment.content: Possible anaphylaxis versus allergic reaction status post wasp sting.
Assessment.source_text: 1. Possible anaphylaxis vs allergic reaction s/p wasp sting

Assessment.content: Assessment is based on shortness of breath/shallow breathing, chest tightness, lip tingling, and rash.
Assessment.source_text: • SOB/shallow breathing + chest tightness + lip tingling + rash

Plan_of_Care.content: Patient advised to call an ambulance immediately and not to be driven by his wife.
Plan_of_Care.source_text: • Call ambulance now (advised not to be driven by wife)

Plan_of_Care.content: Patient advised to take an antihistamine immediately while awaiting the ambulance.
Plan_of_Care.source_text: • Take antihistamine immediately while awaiting ambulance

Plan_of_Care.content: Urgent emergency department evaluation recommended due to risk of rapid progression and anaphylaxis.
Plan_of_Care.source_text: • ED evaluation urgently due to risk of rapid progression/anaphylaxis

Physical_Findings.content: No physical examination or vital signs documented because this was a remote consultation.
